sources.snippet: Krea 2 - an image generation model from Krea AI. API Docs • Hugging Face (RAW) • Hugging Face (TURBO) • Technical Blog This is the official repository for the open version of Krea 2, an image model trained from scratch focused on creative and stylistic exploration.
